title: Buses and students at Cornell University
author: Tomwsulcer
description: Buses link different sections of campus, as well as travel to and from the town of Ithaca, which is at the bottom of the ridges surrounding Lake Cayuga. A photo from a campus visit to Cornell on April 9, 2012 (actual date of photo).

title: Students waiting for bus and pathways at Cornell University
author: Tomwsulcer
description: Looking across East Avenue toward Sage Hall and the Johnson School of Management. A photo from a campus visit to Cornell on April 9, 2012 (actual date of photo).

title: Students walking and crossing streets with clock tower in distance at Cornell University
author: Tomwsulcer
description: The Cornell campus is on a hill. There is little parking so most students walk or take buses to class. A photo from a campus visit to Cornell on April 9, 2012 (actual date of photo).
